stories.summary: Record each run's token usage, cost and turn count from terminal execution telemetry, with zero, absent and invalid telemetry handled and no credential values stored
Show the recorded token usage and cost on the run report, distinguishing not-recorded from zero and enforcing project membership
Register each run's trace with the installation's test-environment identity and record its trace identifier, tolerating disabled tracing and an unavailable trace store
Expire run transcripts, logs and results under the installation retention period (three months by default), keeping audit-critical run metadata and shared bundles
Purge a run's transcripts, logs and results on project-owner request, with authorization, idempotence, an auditable result and a retryable failure
